belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that design greening indoor tropical may influence absolute alpha power roi. The evidence base (3 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

mechanisms.pathway: soft_fascination → involuntary attention → directed attention recovery

latent_variables.name: Mechanism selection
latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Distraction Theory, Attention Restoration Theory (Kaplan)). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of design greening indoor tropical, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of design greening indoor tropical on absolute alpha power roi replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: Which mechanism best explains design greening indoor tropical → absolute alpha power roi?
research_needs.rationale: 2 candidate mechanisms exist. Process tracing would identify the active pathway.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for design greening indoor tropical effects on absolute alpha power roi?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
